WVC-M1-03-A01.evidence: First-run OutputDir-only creation plus 20 empty/malformed/root/property/path cases; exact original diagnostic backups and explicit recovery notices.

WVC-M1-03-A02.evidence: Offline drive/UNC simulated; simulated access exception, real Windows listing ACL denial and real file-as-directory retain exact config bytes without default fallback.

WVC-M1-03-A03.evidence: Isolated APPDATA per case; real read/replace sharing failures, lock contention, stale snapshots, simulated temp/backup/promotion faults, no-clobber temp/backup/file races and menu rollback preserve sentinels.

WVC-M1-03-A04.evidence: Unchanged legacy valid load, nested arrays/null/bool/numeric/Unicode and timestamp round-trip, previous exact-byte backup, depth100 refusal; older PS7 timestamp normalization documented.

sanitized_artifacts: Evidence contains commands/counts and case IDs; raw reports/environment/path diagnostics stay in ignored .test-results/m103-4582ce1.
18 raw reports/logs copied with SHA256 equality verified; five owned diagnostic roots archived (49 files) with hashes checked and removed only after ownership/containment/reparse/process checks.
final_handoff_push: pending; verify externally after final documentation commit
limitations: Initial overlapping PS7 Quick/Targeted hit the harness timeout (Quick 4/1/0/0; Targeted 18/1/4/0, exit1). One termination raced an already exited PID; later no active owned fixture processes remained. Serial reruns passed and original failed reports are retained. Concurrency is an observed circumstance, not a measured root-cause diagnosis.
Full exits1 solely on six existing M1-04 discovery failures (three per host); four media fixtures skip because FFmpeg/FFprobe are absent and eight broader manual/future coverage checks remain NotRun.

No actual disconnected external drive/UNC, network replacement atomicity, power-loss durability or uncoordinated editor race guarantee. Native ACL/read-sharing/replace-sharing/file-as-directory/collision checks complement fault injection.

Unknown nesting above100 is refused. Hosts without DateKind String can normalize ISO timestamp representation through standard PS7 DateTime parsing; PS5.1 and tested PS7.6.5 preserve the tested string exactly.
No config-specific manual/approval gate; broader Explorer/media/manual milestone and release acceptance are not established by these checks. WhatIf/CheckEnvironment remain later CLI work.
